name: kohaku
description: Strategic mastermind skill pack. Native Claude Code plugin; portable to Copilot CLI, Cursor, Cline, Gemini CLI, Codex, Continue.dev, and plain LLM chat via the COMPATIBILITY.md portability layer. Combines Garrett Gee's Hacker Mindset with Blank's (Sora + Shiro from No Game No Life) unified problem-solving methodology. Sits above your execution layer: invoke before goal-binding for meta-game framing, during execution for cold-reads, and after for decision-record reporting. Favours free and open-source resources by default.
